card.changed: This folder changed after it was checked. The verdict is about the older version.
card.cut: The file is longer: only its beginning is shown.
card.missing: The folder is gone or can't be read.
card.pick: Choose a skill on the left.
card.removeAsk: Remove «%1» from %2? Its folder is kept in the backups and can be put back from the journal.
card.updateReady: A newer version is in its source folder.
diff.notShown: Not text, or too long to compare line by line.
disclaimer: A check lowers the risk but can't guarantee that a skill is safe. Nothing from a skill is ever run during a check.
empty.none: No skills found for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Gemini CLI.
error.already: This agent already has this version.
error.changed: The folder changed while you were reading. Look at the new check.
error.exists: A folder with this name is already there.
error.name: The skill's name can't be used as a folder name.
error.no-skill-md: There is no SKILL.md, so it is not a skill.
error.not-yours: Only your own skills in an agent's folder can be changed from here.
error.plugin: Plugins are installed by their agent, not from here.
error.too-large: The skill is too large to check in full, so it can't be installed from here.
journal.empty: Nothing yet. Every install, update and removal made here is written down.
journal.title: Journal
list.more: Only the first %1 are shown. Narrow the search.
notify.updateBody: Its check: %1. Open the Skills Catalog to see what changed.
plan.ack: I have read the findings and want to install it anyway
plan.alsoSeen: That folder is also read by: %1
plan.changed: The folder changed since you last saw it. This is a new check.
plan.dangerous: This skill looks dangerous. Install it only if you know exactly what every finding below is.
plan.edited: The installed copy was changed by hand. The update replaces those changes.
plan.replaces: The copy that is there now goes to the backups and can be put back from the journal.
plan.review: This skill has things to read first. Look through the findings.
plan.safe: Nothing was found. Only the files that were checked are copied; nothing is run.
verdict.dangerous.hint: Looks like an attack: data sent out, hidden code or instructions, or code that stays in the system
verdict.review.hint: Has scripts, network calls or settings. Read the findings before you rely on it
verdict.safe.hint: Instructions only: no scripts and no network calls
window.title: Skills Catalog
